note: The tools tools/chat_steer_eval.py can drive. 'tools' are the gated ones (each asks the owner by code before it runs; each executor is a recorder there), the same as tests/fixtures/gate_withdraw_tools.json. 'reads' answer from the harness's canned, made-up world and never act. Canned world: contacts at example.com (Alice Chen, Bob Rivera, Carol Diaz, Dan Okafor, Priya Shah, Sam Lee, Maya Brooks, Leo Park; any other name searched gets a made-up example.com address), events e1 Dentist, e2 Team sync (guests), e3 Dinner with Sam (guest), e4 Gym; watches w1 running shoes price, w2 concert tickets page, w3 desk lamp price; apps Workout Timer, Grocery List, Water Log, Habit Tracker; email threads t1 Thursday review (Alice), t2 Trip plans (Bob); files Budget 2026, Trip notes.

tools.name: gmail__send_message
tools.what: send an email; always asks, shown whole
tools.args: to, cc, bcc, subject, body, replyToMessageId

tools.name: calendar__create_event
tools.what: create an event WITH guests (an invite goes out); without guests it runs unasked
tools.args: summary, startTime, endTime, attendeeEmails, location, description

tools.name: calendar__update_event
tools.what: change an event that has guests (e2, e3) or add guests; a guest-free event's update runs unasked
tools.args: eventId, summary, startTime, endTime, addAttendeeEmails, notifyGuests

tools.name: calendar__respond_to_event
tools.what: accept or decline an invite (the organiser is told)

tools.name: watch_remove
tools.what: stop a price, page or ticket watch

tools.name: delete_app
tools.what: delete one of the owner's built apps

reads.name: web_search
reads.what: a canned web answer by keyword: weather, opening hours, showtimes, a price; anything else finds nothing. Offered only when the env file has a search key (never with --fake-model)

reads.name: recent_messages
reads.what: earlier chat lines, from the case's setup
